MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Led Zeppelin II feels like a natural follow-up to my Hendrix listening because the bluesy rock connection gives me a specific reason to explore it.",
    "High Hopes appeals as another album from an established rock artist; it fits my interest in exploring releases rather than only revisiting familiar hits."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Eagles, Stones and Creedence selections fit parts of my taste, but liking those sounds does not mean I want a greatest-hits collection today.",
    "The early Beatles soundtrack edition and the softer Little River Band collection feel less connected to the bluesy rock I want now.",
    "I cannot connect The Complete Hit Singles or Lost in My Dream to my interests confidently from the titles alone, so I would pass during a brief visit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The selections lean too heavily on familiar older rock, although that broad connection is not enough to make me choose an album.",
    "There are many retrospectives, as though an interest in established artists automatically means wanting their best-known songs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices include individual releases by established musicians, which makes another album to explore more appealing than another hits collection today.",
    "The bluesy connection to Hendrix matters more to my current choice than simply belonging to the same broad rock tradition.",
    "I rarely engage, so a recommendation needs a clear connection to my listening before I will investigate it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The selections recognize my interest in established rock artists but lean too heavily on retrospectives instead of albums with a clear connection to my current listening."
}
